pages.text: This universal trinket clears Nausea every two seconds while worn, without using power. It separately spends 20 Grimoire power per fire, explosion or demon-caused hit to reduce damage by 15 percent.

A hit that meets several conditions still costs only 20 power. The bewitchment:demons entity tag identifies demonic attackers, including the restored demon families. Ordinary Nether creatures are not automatically demons. Besides the recipe below, a master Hedge Witch may offer this universal trinket for a base 8-16 emeralds.

Make two Diabolical Veins in the Spinning Wheel from Witches' Stitching, Golden Thread, Fiery Unguent and a Heart; recover an Empty Jar. Noble demon merchants can also offer veins at level two. Hellhounds and Athame-harvested Feuerwurms supply horns. Wear this charm and carry a charged Grimoire for damage protection.
